newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P puts Tri Polyta Finance notes BB minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Tri Polyta Finance notes BB minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had assigned a BB minus long-term rating to the US$175 million guaranteed secured notes due in 2003 to be issued by Tri Polyta Finance.
Tri Polyta Finance is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the guarantor, Tri Polyta Indonesia PT.

The rating reflected its position as the largest domestic producer of polypropylene resines in Indonesia and its efficient production facility stituated in the high-growth domestic and Southeast Asian markets, S&P said.

But the credit strengths were offset by Tri Polyta's exposure to volatile pricing for propylene feedstock and polypropylene resins, asset concentration in one site, and the risk associated with the construction and commissioning of additional operating facilities, the funding of which would result in Tri Polyta's current, solid, financial profile becoming significantly more aggressive, it said.
The rating outlook was stable, it said, as the rating contemplated the expected expansion and taking these projects into account, coverages would be much weaker over the next two to three years.
Longer term, ongoing growth and the commodity nature of the company's products would limit rating upside, it added.
